cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Air China 527, you are at gate 211, you have received ATIS Charlie, your destination is Guangzhou, contact Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Air China 527，位于 211 号登机口，已收到 ATIS Charlie，目的地 Guangzhou，联系武汉放行请求 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA527, gate 211, information C, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA527，211 号登机口，信息 C，请求前往 Guangzhou 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 527, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36 right, Lima Kilo Oscar 01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3515.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，武汉放行，可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，离场跑道 36R，Lima Kilo Oscar 01 离场，初始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, LKO 01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3515, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，离场跑道 36R，LKO 01 离场，初始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3515，CCA527。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are on the taxiway Zulu 4, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground and request taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在滑行道 Zulu 4，准备滑行，联系武汉地面请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA527, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA527，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 527, taxi via taxiway Zulu 4, Alpha 3 and Alpha to holding point runway 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，经滑行道 Zulu 4、Alpha 3 和 Alpha 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point runway 36R, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA527。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 527, follow China Southern 737 on Alpha 7, you are number 2 for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，跟随 Alpha 7 上的 China Southern 737，你是第 2 架离场。
cards.referenceText: Roger, follow CSN737 on A7, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跟随 A7 上的 CSN737，CCA527。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at threshold of runway 36 right, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 36R 入口，准备离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA527, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA527，跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 527, cleared for takeoff runway 36 right, surface wind 350, 5 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，跑道 36R 可以起飞，地面风 350，5 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Roger, cleared for takeoff runway 36R, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 36R 可以起飞，CCA527。

cards.audioText: B: After you just takeoff, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 刚起飞后，通过 600 米，联系 Wuhan Departure。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 527, Wuhan Departure, radar identified, climb to 3000 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，Wuhan Departure，雷达识别，爬升到 3000 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3000 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 3000 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升，CCA527。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at cruising level, the thunderstorm is detected in front of you, you want to make a fifteen miles deviation to the east of the current track from Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在巡航高度，前方探测到雷暴，你想向广州管制请求偏离当前航迹以东 15 海里。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA527, our weather radar shows a CB ahead, request 15 miles to the east from current track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CCA527，我们的气象雷达显示前方有 CB，请求从当前航迹向东偏置 15 海里。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 527, offset 15 miles to the east approved, when clear of whether, direct to ATAGA.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，批准向东偏置 15 海里，天气解除后，直飞 ATAGA。
cards.referenceText: Offset 15 miles to the east approved, when clear of whether, direct to ATAGA, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准向东偏置 15 海里，天气解除后，直飞 ATAGA，CCA527。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 527, descend to 4200 meters when ready, reach 4200 meters 10 miles before ATAGA.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，准备好时下降到 4200 米，在 ATAGA 前 10 海里到达 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200 meters when ready, reach 4200 meters 10 miles before ATAGA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 准备好时下降到 4200 米，在 ATAGA 前 10 海里到达 4200 米。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 527, increase rate of descent to greater than 2000 feet per minute until passing 5700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，通过 5700 米前，增加下降率至大于每分钟 2000 英尺。
cards.referenceText: Increase rate of descent to greater than 2000 feet per minute until passing 5700 meters, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过 5700 米前，增加下降率至大于每分钟 2000 英尺，CCA527。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established with Guangzhou Approach, your assigned landing runway is 02 right, you want to land runway 02 left due performance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已与 广州进近 建立联系，指定着陆跑道为 02R，由于性能原因你想落跑道 02L。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CCA527, request runway 02L due performance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CCA527，因性能原因请求跑道 02L。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 527, runway 02 left is not available due runway inspection, runway in use 02 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，跑道 02L 因跑道检查不可用，使用跑道 02R。

cards.audioText: B: You have established on the localizer runway 02 right, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你已建立跑道 02R 航向道，联系 塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CCA527, established on the localizer runway 02R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CCA527，已建立跑道 02R 航向道。

cards.audioText: C: Air China 527, cleared to land 02 right, expedite vacating runway after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C: Air China 527，跑道 02R 可以着陆，着陆后加快脱离跑道。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land 02R, expedite vacating runway after landing, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 02R 可以着陆，着陆后加快脱离跑道，CCA527。
